intro.title: First-Time Sign-In & Branch Selection
intro.subtitle: Secure authentication and multi-branch pharmacy workspace

narration.text: Welcome to MediFlow. In this first tutorial, you will learn how to sign in securely and navigate your pharmacy branch.
narration.caption: Welcome to MediFlow. Learn how to sign in securely and select your pharmacy branch.

narration.text: Enter your registered email address and password. Each staff member has individual credentials for statutory audit trails.
narration.caption: Enter your email and password. Individual logins maintain strict audit compliance.

narration.text: Click Sign In to access your workspace. MediFlow takes you directly to the live pharmacy dashboard overview.
narration.caption: Click Sign In to launch your live pharmacy dashboard overview.

narration.text: At the top of the sidebar, view your active branch. Multi-outlet pharmacies can seamlessly switch between branch locations.
narration.caption: View your active branch at the top sidebar, or switch between store locations.

narration.text: You are now logged in and ready to work. In Part 2, we will explore the screen layout and sidebar navigation shortcut Ctrl+B.
narration.caption: You're ready! Watch Part 2 to master the screen layout and shortcut Ctrl+B.

outro.takeaway: Rule 65 Compliance: Every bill and prescription is tied to the logged-in user ID.
